items.title: Sidney "Jim Little" Brown Interview, 1960-05-27
items.q: And, uh, Sam Morgan, Isaiah Morgan, Andrew Morgan, Roy, Roy Evans? Yeah. The drummer... That was the band.

ctx.x: Well, before electric days, you couldn't hear the bass much on the record. No, you couldn't. Those were electric recording. Do you remember who else was in the band at that time on the records?

Oh, at the time we made the records that day? Uh huh. Let's see, uh, Jim Robinson? Yeah. And, uh, Sam Morgan, Isaiah Morgan, Andrew Morgan, Roy, Roy Evans? Yeah. The drummer. Did you have a guitar player?
Johnny Deer. Mm-hmm. Did you have a guitar player? Johnny Deer.
